original_test_intent: Verify every SMBIOS Type 9 Slot Designation string names the intended system slot in the approved board/riser topology and remains attached to the same Type 9 slot identity after reboot, independent of whether a device is currently installed.
original_method: Collect complete Type 9 records, retain each designation string index/value with handle, slot type, width, usage, length, slot ID and bus-address data when present, compare to the approved board/riser map, then repeat after an approved reboot.
manual_activity: A user approves the board/riser slot map, alias and population policy and reboot plan. A physical silk-screen inspection is optional separate evidence, not inherent to this SMBIOS field check.
required_inputs: System board and riser/card-cage revision/topology map
Rules for empty/unpopulated slots, aliases, duplicate labels and absent bus addresses
Expected Type 9 identity fields including slot ID and segment/bus/device/function where supported
Validated parser plus approved reboot and OOB recovery plan
safety_requirements: Use read-only SMBIOS and optional read-only PCI inventory; do not insert, remove or reseat adapters.
Preserve string index and full Type 9 identity because repeated designations or riser-local numbering can otherwise be misattributed.
Do not treat an unpopulated slot as missing solely because no PCI device enumerates; compare Current Usage and project population policy separately.
Do not claim a physical silk-screen label or electrical route is correct from metadata alone.
Stop on malformed strings, duplicate identity, map drift or reboot failure; no automatic retry.
agent_execution_scope: Collect complete Type 9 records, resolve designations, correlate stable slot identifiers and optionally read-only PCI BDFs, then compare the inventory before/after reboot.
Do not manipulate cards, infer physical labeling or issue PASS/FAIL.
engineer_actions: Approve the board/riser topology, designation aliases and population expectations.
Approve reboot/recovery, arrange physical label inspection only if required, and issue the formal verdict.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: The field name is correct, but grep-only text drops handle, slot ID, usage, topology and bus-address context needed to distinguish repeated or riser-local labels.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Archive complete Type 9 records and compare each resolved Slot Designation with stable slot identifiers, topology fields and any supported BDF mapping against the approved board/riser inventory before and after reboot.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: The Slot Designation scope, Type 9 script and 5/5-minute values are retained.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Resolve each designation string and bind it to Type 9 handle, slot ID, type/width/usage and segment/bus/device/function fields when defined; compare the complete inventory to the exact board/riser map across reboot.
modernized_recommendation.applicable_platform: SMBIOS Type 9 system-slot implementations, including fixed-board and riser topologies.
modernized_recommendation.supported_version: Record SMBIOS, BIOS, board/riser revisions and dmidecode/parser versions; record whether extended bus-address fields are implemented.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: Applicable SMBIOS Type 9 Slot Designation and slot identity semantics, approved platform slot/riser map and installed tool documentation.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds string provenance and topology/stable-identity correlation rather than comparing unlabeled grep fragments.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: No reduction; covers unpopulated and repeated-label slots without relying on transient PCI population.
modernized_recommendation.required_inputs: Exact board/riser slot map and alias/population policy.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: SMBIOS and PCI BDF correlation cannot prove the chassis silk-screen or physical routing without separate inspection.

project_override_considerations: A project may approve different labels for alternate risers or chassis revisions, but must version the map and bind each label to stable Type 9 identity rather than current device population alone.
expected_evidence: Approved system/riser revisions, slot topology/designation map and alias/population policy
Complete pre-reboot Type 9 records with handle, raw string index/value, slot ID, type/width/usage and supported bus address
Per-record topology mapping and optional read-only PCI correlation
Approved reboot/health evidence and equivalent post-reboot inventory/diff
Engineer verdict; optional physical label evidence separately identified

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The source consistently requests the Type 9 designation metadata and persistence check; physical inspection is not stated as core acceptance.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Designation collection and topology comparison are software-automatable after the versioned slot map is supplied.

comparison_to_prior_reviews.deepseek: Adds complete Type 9 topology identity and string provenance.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.gpt_v2: Keeps board-map and no-card-action safeguards while correcting automation capability to FULLY AUTOMATABLE.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.v3_1_improvement: Separates missing project map, optional physical correlation and formal engineer verdict from capability.

review_improvement: Avoids false mismatches from riser variants and false passes from repeated labels by using the complete slot identity rather than text alone.
independent_technical_reasoning: Slot Designation is a Type 9 string whose correctness is deterministic against a versioned board/riser map; physical inspection is optional and not part of the stated core.
